projects.name: Q-FENCE
projects.title: Securing Tomorrow’s Digital Infrastructure with Quantum-Resistant Cryptography
projects.abstract: A hybrid security framework combining classical, quantum and post-quantum cryptographic techniques to protect digital infrastructure.

details.label: Participants
details.value: SETU (Ireland), CSIC, Polito, Uni Luxembourg, UCC, etc.

projects.name: DECIDE

projects.abstract: A virtual chip design platform that broadens access to advanced semiconductor technologies for European startups, SMEs and research institutions.

details.label: Participants
details.value: IMEC (BE), CEA (FR), Fraunhofer (DE), IHP (DE), Silicon Austria Labs, CSIC, etc.

projects.name: QUBIP
projects.title: Quantum-oriented Update to Browsers and Infrastructures for the PQ Transition
projects.abstract: Methods and recommended practices for migrating browsers and infrastructure to post-quantum cryptography, with a focus on making the transition repeatable.

details.label: Participants
details.value: LINKS Foundation, CSIC, Tampere Univ, Telefónica I+D, POLITO, etc.

projects.name: SQPRIM
projects.title: Secure post-quantum cryptographic primitives
projects.abstract: Optical and ultrasound physically unclonable functions (PUFs) for robust device identification in the post-quantum era.

projects.name: GoIT
projects.title: Open-source hardware: a step towards Europe’s digital Independence
projects.abstract: Open-source silicon and hardware platforms to support European digital independence and technological sovereignty.

details.label: Participants
details.value: Elektronikas un Datorzinatnu Instituts (LV), ITEFI-CSIC, Sorbonne Université (FR), etc.

projects.name: SPIRS
projects.title: Secure Platform for ICT Systems Rooted at the Silicon Manufacturing Process
projects.abstract: An open hardware platform combining a dedicated root of trust and a processor core. The project explores secure boot, trusted execution and decentralised trust for IoT, 5G and Industry 4.0 systems.

details.label: Participants
details.value: IMSE-CNM-CSIC, ITEFI-CSIC, POLITO, Telefónica I+D, Links Foundation, etc.

projects.abstract: Physical unclonable functions and cryptographic primitives in photonic integrated circuits, with a focus on miniaturisation and standard CMOS fabrication.

details.label: PI
